svg.title: Direct Sampling realizations
svg.desc: A 64 by 64 categorical training image of meandering channels and three 32 by 32 Direct Sampling realizations conditioned on the same fourteen hard data, which each realization honours.
svg.text: Direct Sampling: a training image and three conditional realizations
Circles are the 14 hard data (filled: channel, open: background), honoured in every realization; the channel
geometry between them is copied from the training image. Threshold 0.05, 20 neighbours, half the image scanned.
